title: Gaming Zone
one_liner: Multi-tenant booking and billing OS for gaming cafés.
note: Player app, admin dashboard and a per-station PC agent that keeps billing correct through a network outage.

title: Companion AI
one_liner: AI companion chat, character creation and image generation on mobile.
note: Character discovery, group chat, a text-to-image studio and a credit economy, all behind an age gate.

title: Easy Mech
one_liner: Roadside assistance marketplace — owners, mechanics, dispatch, live tracking.
note: Near-typeless onboarding by camera, built in parallel against a live backend that was still being written.

title: Affiliate Platform
one_liner: Click-to-commission tracking, from embedded tracker to payout.
note: A public ingestion endpoint that cannot lose a conversion, because a lost conversion is money nobody gets paid.

title: Ledger
one_liner: A dark, document-grade UI for an AI generation platform.
note: Pick a base model and a LoRA once; that choice follows you into every tool on the platform.

title: Video Encoding Pipeline
one_liner: Batch MP4 → adaptive HLS, with validation that catches broken output.
note: Enumerates each GPU's real encode capability, then runs two codec ladders on two cards at once.
